023public class SwarmLauncherEffect implements OnFireEffectPlugin, EveryFrameWeaponEffectPlugin, SwarmLaunchingWeapon {
024
025        public static String CONSTRUCTION_SWARM_WING = "construction_swarm_wing";
026        public static String CONSTRUCTION_SWARM_VARIANT = "attack_swarm_Construction";
027        public static String RECLAMATION_SWARM_WING = "reclamation_swarm_wing";
028        public static String RECLAMATION_SWARM_VARIANT = "attack_swarm_Reclamation";
029        
030        public static String ATTACK_SWARM_HULL = "attack_swarm";
031        public static String ATTACK_SWARM_WING = "attack_swarm_wing";
032        public static String ATTACK_SWARM_VARIANT = "attack_swarm_Attack";
033        public static String SWARM_LAUNCHER = "swarm_launcher";
034        public static float IMPACT_VOLUME_MULT = 0.33f;
035        
036        public static float INITIAL_SPAWN_DELAY = 1f;
037        
038        public static Map<String, Integer> FRAGMENT_NUM = new HashMap<>();
039        public static Map<String, Integer> SWARM_RADIUS = new HashMap<>();
040        public static Map<String, Integer> WING_SIZE = new HashMap<>();
041        public static Map<String, String> WING_IDS = new HashMap<>();
042        
043        static {
044                FRAGMENT_NUM.put(ATTACK_SWARM_WING, 50);
045                SWARM_RADIUS.put(ATTACK_SWARM_WING, 20);
046                WING_SIZE.put(ATTACK_SWARM_WING, 4);
047                WING_IDS.put(SWARM_LAUNCHER, ATTACK_SWARM_WING);
048                
049                FRAGMENT_NUM.put(CONSTRUCTION_SWARM_WING, 50);
050                SWARM_RADIUS.put(CONSTRUCTION_SWARM_WING, 50);
051        }
052        
053        protected FighterWingAPI currWing = null;
054        protected boolean waitUntilOneLeft = false;
055        protected float elapsed = 0f;
056        
057        public SwarmLauncherEffect() {
058                
059        }
060        
061        @Override
062        public void advance(float amount, CombatEngineAPI engine, WeaponAPI weapon) {
063                ShipAPI ship = weapon.getShip();
064                if (ship == null) return;
065                
066                if (weapon.usesAmmo() && weapon.getAmmo() <= 0) return;
067
068                elapsed += amount;
069                if (elapsed < INITIAL_SPAWN_DELAY || ship.hasTag(ThreatShipConstructionScript.SHIP_UNDER_CONSTRUCTION)) {
070                        weapon.setForceDisabled(true);
071                        return;
072                }
073                
074                RoilingSwarmEffect swarm = RoilingSwarmEffect.getSwarmFor(ship);
075                if (swarm instanceof DwellerShroud) swarm = null;
076                int active = swarm == null ? 0 : swarm.getNumActiveMembers();
077                int required = FRAGMENT_NUM.get(getWingId(weapon));
078                boolean disable = active < required;
079                //disable = false;
080                int max = getWingSize(weapon);
081                int swarmsActive = 0;
082                if (currWing != null) swarmsActive = currWing.getWingMembers().size();
083                waitUntilOneLeft |= currWing != null && swarmsActive >= max;
084                if (currWing != null && currWing.getWingMembers().size() == 1 && currWing.getLeader() != null) {
085                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(currWing.getLeader().getLocation(), weapon.getLocation());
086                        if (dist > 1000f) {
087                                waitUntilOneLeft = true;
088                        }
089                }
090                if (waitUntilOneLeft) {
091                        if (currWing != null && ((swarmsActive <= 1 && max > 1) || swarmsActive <= 0 && max <= 1)) {
092                                waitUntilOneLeft = false;
093                                currWing = null;
094                        } else {
095                                disable = true;
096                        }
097                }
098                
099                if (currWing == null && swarm != null) {
100                        int preferred = getPreferredNumFragmentsToFireConsideringAllWeapons(ship);
101                        preferred = (int) Math.min(preferred, swarm.params.baseMembersToMaintain * 0.9f);
102                        if (active < preferred ) {
103                                disable = true;
104                        }
105                }
106                
107                weapon.setForceDisabled(disable);
108                
109                boolean playerShip = Global.getCurrentState() == GameState.COMBAT &&
110                                Global.getCombatEngine() != null && Global.getCombatEngine().getPlayerShip() == ship;
111                if (playerShip) {
112                        Global.getCombatEngine().maintainStatusForPlayerShip(this,
113                                        Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("ui", "icon_tactical_swarm_launcher"),
114                                        weapon.getDisplayName(), 
115                                        "SWARMS ACTIVE: " + swarmsActive, // + " / " + max,
116                                        swarmsActive <= 0);
117                }
118                
119                weapon.setCustom(currWing);
120                
121                if (ship.getVariant().hasHullMod(HullMods.THREAT_HULLMOD)) {
122                        weapon.setAmmo(weapon.getMaxAmmo());
123                }
124                
125                if (disable) {
126                        return;
127                }
128                
129                weapon.setForceFireOneFrame(true);
130        }
131        
132        public String getWingId(WeaponAPI weapon) {
133                //String wingId = WING_IDS.get(SWARM_LAUNCHER);
134                String wingId = WING_IDS.get(weapon.getId());
135                if (wingId != null) return wingId;
136                return ATTACK_SWARM_WING;
137        }
138        
139        public int getWingSize(WeaponAPI weapon) {
140                float wingSize = WING_SIZE.get(getWingId(weapon));
141                if (weapon.getShip() != null) {
142                        wingSize = weapon.getShip().getMutableStats().getDynamic().getValue(
143                                        Stats.SWARM_LAUNCHER_WING_SIZE_MOD, wingSize);
144                }
145                //wingSize = 20;
146                //wingSize = 1;
147                return (int) Math.round(wingSize);
148        }
149        
150        public void onFire(DamagingProjectileAPI projectile, WeaponAPI weapon, CombatEngineAPI engine) {
151                
152                //FighterWingSpecAPI spec = Global.getSettings().getFighterWingSpec(ATTACK_SWARM_WING);
153
154                CombatFleetManagerAPI manager = engine.getFleetManager(projectile.getOwner());
155                manager.setSuppressDeploymentMessages(true);
156                ShipAPI leader = manager.spawnShipOrWing(getWingId(weapon), 
157                                                                projectile.getLocation(), projectile.getFacing(), 0f, null);
158                leader.getWing().setSourceShip(projectile.getSource());
159                manager.setSuppressDeploymentMessages(false);
160                
161                Vector2f takeoffVel = Misc.getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(projectile.getFacing());
162                takeoffVel.scale(leader.getMaxSpeed() * 1f);
163                
164                //Global.getSoundPlayer().playSound("threat_swarm_launched", 1f, 1f, projectile.getLocation(), takeoffVel);
165                
166                for (ShipAPI curr : leader.getWing().getWingMembers()) {
167                        curr.setDoNotRender(true);
168                        curr.setExplosionScale(0f);
169                        curr.setHulkChanceOverride(0f);
170                        curr.setImpactVolumeMult(IMPACT_VOLUME_MULT);
171                        curr.getArmorGrid().clearComponentMap(); // no damage to weapons/engines
172
173                        if (currWing != null) {
174                                if (curr.getWing() != null) {
175                                        curr.getWing().removeMember(curr);
176                                        // really important, otherwise this doesn't get cleaned up
177                                        manager.removeDeployed(curr.getWing(), false);
178                                }
179                                curr.setWing(currWing);
180                                currWing.addMember(curr);
181                        }
182                        
183                        Vector2f.add(curr.getVelocity(), takeoffVel, curr.getVelocity());
184                }
185                
186                currWing = leader.getWing();
187                
188                RoilingSwarmEffect sourceSwarm = RoilingSwarmEffect.getSwarmFor(weapon.getShip());
189                if (sourceSwarm instanceof DwellerShroud) sourceSwarm = null;
190                if (sourceSwarm != null) {
191                        RoilingSwarmEffect swarm = FragmentSwarmHullmod.createSwarmFor(leader);
192                        
193                        int required = FRAGMENT_NUM.get(getWingId(weapon));
194                        int transfer = required;
195                        
196                        if (transfer > 0) {
197                                Vector2f loc = new Vector2f(takeoffVel);
198                                loc.scale(0.5f);
199                                Vector2f.add(loc, leader.getLocation(), loc);
200                                sourceSwarm.transferMembersTo(swarm, transfer, loc, 100f);
201                        }
202                        
203                }
204                
205//              if (currWing.getWingMembers().size() >= getWingSize(weapon)) {
206//                      currWing = null;
207//              }
208                
209                engine.removeEntity(projectile);
210        }
211        
212        public int getPreferredNumFragmentsToFireConsideringAllWeapons(ShipAPI ship) {
213                RoilingSwarmEffect swarm = RoilingSwarmEffect.getSwarmFor(ship);
214                if (swarm instanceof DwellerShroud) swarm = null;
215                if (swarm == null) return 0;
216                
217                int req = 0;
218                for (WeaponAPI w : ship.getAllWeapons()) {
219                        if (w.getEffectPlugin() instanceof SwarmLaunchingWeapon) {
220                                if (w.isFiring()) continue;
221                                SwarmLaunchingWeapon effect = (SwarmLaunchingWeapon) w.getEffectPlugin();
222                                req += effect.getPreferredNumFragmentsToFire(w);
223                        }
224                }
225                return req;
226        }
227
228        @Override
229        public int getPreferredNumFragmentsToFire(WeaponAPI weapon) {
230                Integer required = FRAGMENT_NUM.get(getWingId(weapon));
231                if (required == null) return 0;
232                int wingSize = getWingSize(weapon);
233                int num = Math.min(wingSize, 2);
234                return required * num;
235        }
